description: Source code for Kubernetes flow schema storage, including REST storage implementation, status subresource handling, and storage setup.

classes.name: FlowSchemaStorage
classes.description: Implements storage for flow schema, holding REST and status REST handlers.

classes.name: REST
classes.description: Implements REST storage for flow schemas against etcd, embedding generic registry store.

classes.name: StatusREST
classes.description: Handles the status subresource for flow schemas, including get, update, and reset fields.

methods.name: NewREST
methods.description: Creates and returns REST storage objects for flow schemas and their status subresource.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new flow schema object.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources on shutdown; no explicit destruction of shared store.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a flow schema object from storage.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the status subset of a flow schema object.

methods.name: GetResetFields
methods.description: Returns reset fields for the status subresource.

methods.name: ConvertToTable
methods.description: Converts stored object to a table format for display.
